• Just now
Seen • Just now
Once your order ships, the delivery timeline depends on the shipping method:
Free Standard Delivery (via USPS® or UPS®): Delivery timelines are estimated by the shippers once the order has been produced. Specific delivery dates cannot be scheduled using ground shipping methods.
Doorstep/Curbside Delivery (for heavier items over 150 lbs): After your item ships, the carrier (SEKO or BTX) will contact you to schedule a delivery appointment once it arrives at your local terminal. The tracking page will show an expected arrival date to the terminal, but that's not your actual delivery date — the carrier will reach out to set up the appointment.
In-Home Delivery with Setup: This upgraded service includes a scheduled delivery appointment on your chosen date.
For example, Grand Luxe Mattresses typically take 3-4 weeks to ship, with delivery taking an additional 1-2 weeks.
